content.tex: This investigation looks at the way a virus spreads in plants in a field.

parts.text: In a field there are a large number of plants in a straight line. The diagram shows the plants near the middle of the field. On Day 1, one of the plants is infected with a virus (V). V On Day 2, that plant is dead (D) and the virus infects the plants next to it. D V V This continues from day to day so this is the pattern on Day 3. D D V V D The diagram shows that the virus infects two more plants on day 3. So the total number of plants that are infected or dead is five.
